reference.citation: Ying Z, Song Y, Zhu J. Front Pharmacol. 2022 Apr 25;13:834113.
reference.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Anti-CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor-T Cell Immunotherapy in Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Large B-Cell Lymphoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
reference.notes: Single-arm proportions, random-effects model (DerSimonian & Laird). BOR=best overall response rate; BCR=best complete response rate. I2 not reported in abstract.

caveats: LLM-drafted; human-verify against Ying 2022 full text (PMID 35548364, DOI 10.3389/fphar.2022.834113).
Published values extracted from abstract only; all values in percent scale.
I2 not reported in abstract; set to null throughout.
k=27 studies, n=1687 patients in reference; engine search bounded to 2021-07-31.
group=ALL because subgroup_field is empty (no stratification by product class).
BOR (best overall response) mapped to field 'orr'; BCR (best complete response) mapped to 'complete_response_rate'.
